resources.string: Crash reports and interface, player and network logs
One detailed report for the interface, gestures, video, conversion and network requests

Start recording, reproduce the problem, then return here to stop and share one report. Detailed recording is always used. For video freezes, wait 5–10 seconds before stopping.

The report includes the device model, Android and app versions, installed APK hash, screen geometry, keyboard state, touch dispatch, selection positions, player, conversion and Back gesture events. Network events include connection types, response codes and website challenge stages. Technical events may also appear in the Android system log.

Message text, clipboard contents, passwords, links, file contents, accounts and device identifiers are not recorded. Nothing is sent automatically.
